name: Name
label: Name
conditionNot: Applies when the fact does not hold
conditionCompound: A condition over several facts cannot be edited here
parallelWithPrevious: Proceeds together with the step before
noLane: Add a lane before adding a step

refusal.unknown-subject: The part could not be found
refusal.lane-in-use: Acts are performed in this lane, so it cannot be removed
refusal.duplicate-lane: A lane with the same id exists
refusal.duplicate-section: A section with the same id exists
refusal.duplicate-step: A step with the same id exists
refusal.duplicate-act: An act with the same id exists
refusal.duplicate-jump: A jump with the same id exists
refusal.step-without-acts: A step needs at least one act
refusal.act-without-lanes: An act needs at least one lane
refusal.act-repeats-lane: An act cannot name the same lane twice
refusal.jump-unknown-from: The step the jump leaves does not exist
refusal.jump-unknown-to: The step the jump goes to does not exist
refusal.jump-to-self: The jump leaves and reaches the same step
refusal.jump-target-count: Set either a step or another procedure, not both
refusal.repeat-unknown-end: The step that ends the repeat does not exist
refusal.repeat-end-not-after: The step that ends a repeat must come after the repeating step
refusal.parallel-not-adjacent: Steps that proceed together must be neighbours
refusal.parallel-single: Proceeding together takes two or more steps
refusal.parallel-spans-sections: Steps that proceed together must be in one section

consequence.jump-removed: Jumps connected to the step were removed with it
consequence.repeat-cleared: A repeat was cleared because its ending step is gone
consequence.parallel-cleared: One step was left, so it no longer proceeds together
consequence.parallel-joined: The step stands between steps that proceed together and joins them
